sections.content: 'Mientras' (while) is the most common conjunction used with the imperfecto. It introduces ongoing background actions that were happening at the same time as something else.

items.en: While (I was) cooking, I listened to the radio.

items.es: Mientras mis padres dormían, yo salí.
items.en: While my parents were sleeping, I went out.
While we were talking, Juan arrived.

sections.content:
Pattern 1 (both simultaneous, both imperfecto): Mientras leía, ella escribía.
Pattern 2 (background + interrupting event): Mientras leía, sonó el teléfono.
The event that interrupts always goes in the indefinido.

items.en: I fell while I was running.

items.es: Vi a Pedro mientras esperaba el autobús.
items.en: I saw Pedro while I was waiting for the bus.
